A '''Camouflage Suit''',<ref name="UG">{{JournalCite|1|Uninvited Guests}}</ref> or '''camosuit'''<ref name="Blaze">{{JournalCite|8|Blaze of Glory (short story)}}</ref> was a piece of clothing that helped to disguise an individual on the battlefield. [[Maidtha Fait]] wore a Camouflage Suit while leading [[Darius squad]] during the [[Battle of Taul]].<ref name="UG" /> [[Greezim Trentacal]]'s guards on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gabredor III/Legends|Gabredor III]] wore camosuits to blend in with the world's jungle environment.<ref name="Blaze" />
